title: Canonical crew pairing-rostering problem (layer 1)
description: Solver-independent canonical input for the pairing-rostering pipeline. Every import adapter (GERAD, BTS, SSIM, CSV) must emit exactly this format; everything downstream (column generation, covering IP, completion, rostering, validators, gate) consumes only this. v2 (2026-07-17, data-formalization doc, канон v2) adds OPTIONAL entities — qualifications, contracts, dutyHistory, costComponents — every v1 payload stays valid unchanged.

formatVersion.description: Canonical format version; absent means v1

provenance.description: Where this payload came from (adapter, source data, conversion check artifact) — required for new imports, optional for historical instances

flightLegId.description: OPTIONAL first-class operating-leg identity (C01/C02 phase 3). Importers materialize it as flightNumber+'|'+departureUTCDateTime; when present it must be unique across the payload (conditional referential check) and downstream readers prefer it over flightNumber. Absent on historical payloads — flightNumber stays the identity then. The id persists through retimes (identity, not a formula).

departureUTCDateTime.description: ISO seconds: naive means UTC; an explicit offset ('+03:00', 'Z') is recalculated to UTC by the shared parser — never silently truncated. Garbage and fractional seconds are rejected at admission (external audit R6, P0-03).

flightAssignments.description: Crew slots: one entry per required seat per flight

crewSlotId.description: OPTIONAL first-class crew-seat identity (C01/C02 phase 3). When present it must be unique across flightAssignments (conditional referential check); the Kotlin solver uses it as @PlanningId, falling back to id when absent.

flightLegId.description: OPTIONAL leg reference by first-class identity (C01/C02 phase 3). When present it must name an existing flights[].flightLegId (conditional referential check); readers prefer it over the flight (flightNumber) reference for leg identity. The flight field stays for backward compatibility.

qualifications.description: v2 QualificationValidity: temporal validity of crew clearances (dated kinds carry validTo; recency carries event counters). Mirrors the qualifications feature's record shape so the compliance calendar can read the canon directly.

contracts.description: v2 EmploymentContract: per-employee pay/credit terms. Absent fields fall back to the airline-level pay config (pay_credit.PAY_DEFAULTS). At most one contract per employee (referential check).

dutyHistory.description: v2 DutyHistory: accumulated duty/block/credit per employee per closed month — the carry-over at the month boundary that cumulative-limit rules need. Unique per (employee, month) (referential check).

costComponents.description: v2 CostComponent: named elements of the airline's cost model, each with an amount and a unit the costing layer understands.
